format: One shard: routed experts NVFP4 in layers 0-19 and MXFP8 in layers 20-23; attention projections, router, loop controllers, embeddings and lm_head BF16. mtp.safetensors is the bundled DSpark draft model (downloaded and checked with the checkpoint as shipped; SparkInkling drafts with DFlash2).
why: Thinking Machines' own release, served as shipped in Strict mode. The sha256 values are Hugging Face's LFS object ids at this revision; the small JSON and template files are fetched at the same revision and not hashed here.

overlay.format: ModelOpt NVFP4 (E2M1 codes, an E4M3 scale per 16 inputs, an F32 weight_scale_2 per tensor or expert) under the transformers module names: the attention q, k, v, output-gate, output and relative-bias projections of all 24 layers, the vocabulary head, and the routed experts of layers 20-23.
overlay.why: Spark mode only: calibrated NVFP4 copies (GPTQ, wide scale search) of the BF16 projections and the MXFP8 experts, about half the bytes a token reads. KL to the checkpoint as shipped 0.0081 [0.0075, 0.0088] on 224 held-out documents (97.0% top-1); receipts in the overlay repository.

dflash2.method: DFlash2 (block diffusion with a candidate selector)
dflash2.status: loaded by default (DRAFTER=dflash2): the repository's config.json and model.safetensors served as the engine's DFlash drafter directory
dflash2.why: incoai's DFlash2 drafter for Inkling 2 Mini reads the same four target taps as the bundled DSpark, accepts more of its drafts, and decoded 17-22% faster at one request (0.5.0 replaces DSpark with it). The sha256 is Hugging Face's LFS object id at this revision; config.json is fetched at the same revision and not hashed here.
